name: ask-card
title: Ask Card
description: The one card an agent uses to ask a person's OK: the server's choices in its order (never a filled primary), the preview of what it would send first, bundles answered item by item, and one muted line once settled.

meta.whenToUse: An agent waits on a person's OK for a tool call: in a chat, in For you, in a push preview.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent offering a next step the person may ignore (ForYouCard), or a question with answers to fill (AgentQuestionForm).
